lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Reordering sign-in showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path layout changes did not improve conversion across 2 tests, with major changes hurting performance.

Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, choose_path/hint, choose_path/redesign, finish/hint, finish/layout, finish/redesign, home/hint, home/notification, sign_in/copy, and sign_in/redesign, as each has only 1 test.

candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop (60.9% conversion) and support reported custom pets looking wrong or failing (3 emails).

new_pet_style.body: Choose your preferred visual aesthetic before uploading reference photos.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an art style selection screen inside onboarding.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Path selection hints (choose_path, hint) were helpful, winning in both tests.
Home wait_info changes (3 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), and finish notification changes (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Adoption stage redesigns (3 tests) and path selection layout changes (2 tests) did not improve conversion, with larger redesigns hurting performance.

Evidence is still thin for single-test categories including adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, choose_path/redesign, finish/copy, finish/hint, finish/layout, finish/redesign, home/hint, home/notification, home/redesign, sign_in/copy, sign_in/hint, and sign_in/redesign.
